title: Carbonate bond order
statement:
What average C–O bond order follows from equal weighting of the three carbonate Lewis contributors?

[_]{a}

explanations: The three equivalent contributions give 4 divided by 3.
This would average a pair of values 1 and 2 equally.
This keeps only the double-bond role.

hints: Each contributor has one double bond and two single bonds.
Focus on the same C–O position in all three.
solution: Each contributor has one double bond and two single bonds. Focus on the same C–O position in all three. Average its values 2, 1 and 1. The three equivalent contributions give 4 divided by 3.
